lead: A property default may not be an array with entries in it.
body: `public array<string> $rows = ["a" => "x"];` is `E0472` (*"a property default must be a `array<string>` literal"*, which reads as if the literal were mistyped), and `[]` is the only array a declaration may carry. Fill a pre-filled array property with element writes after the `new` or in `constructor`; a `public static` one has no constructor, so its writes are top-level statements.
